verdict.rationale: MX documents a dedicated test platform with four test institutions to connect against (mx-docs-8). It also offers free developer API keys from the Client Dashboard (mx-docs-32) and guidance on testing the Connect Widget (mx-docs-23). Together these support exercising the integration without real end-user financial data. missing for 10: an explicit statement that the developer/test environment is isolated from production data, detail on sandbox data scope and behaviors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
